facts.fact: StackAdapt was named a winner of the inaugural ADWEEK Tech Stack Awards in the Buy-Side Programmatic Product/Platform category, according to StackAdapt's press release.
facts.quote: today announced it has been named a winner of the inaugural ADWEEK Tech Stack Awards in the Buy-Side Programmatic Product/Platform category

facts.fact: The ADWEEK Tech Stack Awards span more than 20 categories, according to StackAdapt's description of the awards.
facts.quote: Spanning more than 20 categories, the ADWEEK Tech Stack Awards honour the technologies and teams powering the future of advertising.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's own claim is that its AI-powered StackAdapt Marketing Platform performs 465 billion automated optimizations per second.
facts.quote: With 465 billion automated optimizations per second, the AI-powered StackAdapt Marketing Platform seamlessly connects brand and performance marketing

facts.fact: StackAdapt's first flagship client event series, Conversion, brought together more than 150 brands and agencies across North America, EMEA, and APAC, according to StackAdapt.
facts.quote: brought together more than 150 brands and agencies across North America, EMEA, and APAC for strategy sessions and innovation showcases
